mcqs.question: Who won the SAFF U-20 title in Male on April 3 after the final against India ended 0–0 and was decided on penalties?
mcqs.explanation: Bangladesh won the SAFF U-20 title by defeating India 4–3 on penalties after a 0–0 draw. This was Bangladesh’s second title. India was the defeated finalist, while FIFA and OCA were not the winners of this tournament.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about the 2027 World Para Athletics Championships is incorrect?
options: The championships will be held in Tashkent.
The event will be the first World Para Athletics Championships in Central Asia.
The 2027 championships will be the 13th edition.
The championships will be held in June 2028.
mcqs.explanation: The incorrect statement is that the championships will be held in June 2028; they are scheduled for June 2027. Tashkent will host the 13th edition, which will be the first World Para Athletics Championships in Central Asia.
